scope: Bounded prompt-only review-suggestion utility follow-up; same stock350 and runtime. Three variants plus baseline.
normalization: Independent author used text instead of raw; a separate fixture adds raw equal to text. Every original and expected string remains unchanged. Initial harness loads stopped before inference on missing raw key; no policy changed.
prompt_selection: Occurrence variant selected on complaint plus old96; unseen16 opened only after prompt freeze; no subsequent tuning.
production_prompt_verification: Selected sidecar messages/options exactly match frozen experiment with actual Rust candidate ordering [id,kind,text].
ordering_caveat: Initial hand-constructed candidate dictionaries used [id,text,kind] and returned [3]; Rust-produced dictionaries use [id,kind,text] and baseline/selected return [0] for the same complaint. Use Rust ordering for production conclusions.
quality_decision: Usefulness improves on old96 and is unchanged on independent16, but harmful deletions remain. Only review suggestions; not validated for automatic delivery. Reported sentence still loses only one filler.
artifact_policy: User-supplied test sentence and synthetic fixtures only. No other private transcripts, credentials, weights, environments or generated logs.
portable_changes: Root-path constant removed; no prompt/policy changes. Frozen original source hashes retained in frozen-occurrences.json.
